resume point, then live ones. Each message is ``{kind, seq, server, data}``. A ``server`` event's player data
(Steam IDs, GUIDs, kick reasons) needs ``players.view``; ``job`` events need ``jobs.view``. Job progress
comes at most every 5 s per job and is not replayed; a comment every 15 s keeps the connection open.

no_person, not_allowed.

operation, or a caller who may publish, gets 409 (code publish_instead).
